_about: story 5043 (C10 ⑥): the drafts the app puts into a room composer from an element the person picked. The app (desktop-electron/src/agent-browser/pick-model.ts) must produce exactly these; the web (apps/web, the chat message renderer) must draw them as plain text — no link, no mention, no work-item reference, no image. The mobile repository keeps this file; the web keeps the same file byte for byte.
